criterion_text: The authenticated client integrates with Server's access policy so an Agent receives only scoped internal digest grants, not upstream OCI Registry credentials or unapproved cross-tenant image visibility.

verifiers.summary: Server-owned import authorization gates pull before I/O and credentials, Agent-facing grants carry only local digests, and the Agent dependency graph excludes the registry feature

evidence.value: exact SHA 1248d82386685d1e927185ca5c4d3649c542ab5c: a Server-owned authorizer denial and a cross-tenant tenant-a/tenant-b denial both failed before any registry HTTP request or credential-provider call, and before any catalog/tag write; the imported Agent-facing grant contained only local Manifest/Config/EROFS digests with no provider secret, username, bearer token or registry URL; the private registry Bearer challenge downloaded with only repository:team/private:pull, refused a challenge scope naming another repository, and redacted credential Debug output; the Server integration test supplied a Server-owned secret provider and tenant policy, denied a tenant-b import before any HTTP request or provider call, and left no local tag/blob; cargo metadata shows nession-erofs default features include registry while nession-agent declares default-features=false with only cache,mount
